data.name: Gordie
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Scottish word 'gord' meaning 'spear' and 'ie' meaning 'thrust'. Gordie can be interpreted as 'thrust of the spear'. Historically, this name has been used among Scottish clans as a symbol of bravery and protection.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes strength and courage in the face of adversity.

in_hebrew.name: גורדי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גורדי מקורו כנראה מהמילה העברית 'גדר' או מהשורש 'גור', שפירושו להיות חזק או גבורה. במסגרת השמות הנוצריים, גורדי עשוי להיות קשור לנושאים של חוזק רוחני או הגנה אלוהית, בהתייחסות למורשת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד.

in_greek.name: Γκόρντι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γκόρντι πιθανόν να συνδέεται με τη λατινική ή αγγλική μορφή του ονόματος, που σχετίζεται με την έννοια της δύναμης ή γενναιότητας. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, τέτοια ονόματα συχνά αντανακλούν τις αρετές που οι γονείς επιθυμούν για το παιδί τους.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gordie has historical ties to Scottish culture. During ancient battles, clans would honored and recognized their brave warriors by bestowing them with unique names reflecting their strength, courage, and prowess. Gordie, derived from the Old Scottish word 'gord' meaning 'spear' and 'ie' meaning 'thrust', represents the thrill of war and valor embodied in each warrior who bears this name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gordie carries a profound spiritual meaning as well. 'Spear' as a component of the name suggests the concept of protection- a shield between the bearer and potential harm. This name symbolizes the defensive and supportive role that the divine plays in the life of the individual. It highlights the idea of a higher power watching over and safeguarding His people. Additionally, it can represent the "thrust" or powerful expression of a deep faith, illustrating the spiritual drive with which many individuals lead their lives.
